notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
description:
Cast Beastcaller Savant for {G}, triggering Felidar Retreat and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Felidar Retreat's trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
The Cat Beast token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Tap Beastcaller Savant, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand.
Repeat.
